create.name: Mark Nepo
create.bio:
Mark Nepo is an American poet and spiritual writer who has spent more than half a century teaching poetry, creative expression and the inner life. He is best known for The Book of Awakening, a year of short daily reflections that became a New York Times bestseller and has sold over a million copies. Since then he has published more than two dozen books of prose and verse, from Seven Thousand Ways to Listen to The Fifth Season and The Language of the Soul, alongside many audio recordings. Oprah Winfrey has featured him on Super Soul Sunday and took him on her 2014 Life You Want tour.

His teaching blends poems, stories and insights from many faith traditions into quiet questions about how to live wholeheartedly, listen closely and stay near what is sacred in ordinary days. He guides small yearlong journeys, short online webinar series, and weekend or weeklong retreats at places such as Omega Institute in Rhinebeck, New York, the Modern Elder Academy in Baja and the Sophia Institute in Charleston. A favourite method is to trace familiar words back to their roots and let their older meanings open up conversation.

books.title: The Book of Awakening: Having the Life You Want by Being Present to the Life You Have (20th Anniversary Edition)
books.author: Mark Nepo
books.description: A reflection for every day of the year, each pairing a short personal story or insight with a suggestion for meditation or journalling. Readers often use it as a morning companion; this edition marks two decades in print.

books.title: Seven Thousand Ways to Listen: Staying Close to What Is Sacred
books.author: Mark Nepo
books.description: Essays on listening as a spiritual discipline: to other people, to the world and to the quiet inside. Each chapter closes with questions to reflect on alone or with others.

books.title: The Book of Soul: 52 Paths to Living What Matters
books.author: Mark Nepo
books.description: Fifty-two short chapters, one for each week, that move through themes such as purpose, kindness and staying open. Every chapter ends with a practice or journal prompt.

books.title: The One Life We're Given: Finding the Wisdom That Waits in Your Heart
books.author: Mark Nepo
books.description: A collection of meditative essays about meeting life as it actually is and finding meaning in the experience we already have. Stories from friends, history and myth sit alongside reflection questions.

books.title: More Together Than Alone: Discovering the Power and Spirit of Community in Our Lives and in the World
books.author: Mark Nepo
books.description: Gathers stories of communities across cultures and centuries to show how people hold each other up. He asks what real belonging looks like and offers prompts for reflection and conversation.

books.title: Drinking from the River of Light: The Life of Expression
books.author: Mark Nepo
books.description: A book about creativity as a way of being alive rather than a talent for the few. It moves between his own path as a poet, the lives of artists and exercises for anyone wanting to express what they feel.

books.title: Falling Down and Getting Up: Discovering Your Inner Resilience and Strength
books.author: Mark Nepo
books.description: Short meditations on stumbling and rising again, drawing on stories from many traditions as well as his own life. It treats setbacks as part of the path rather than a detour from it.

books.title: You Don't Have to Do It Alone: The Power of Friendship
books.author: Mark Nepo
books.description: A warm book on friendship as a spiritual practice, looking at how friends shape us and how we can show up for each other. Reflection questions follow each section.

books.title: The Fifth Season
books.author: Mark Nepo
books.description: Written for people in the second half of life, this book explores creativity as something that can deepen with age. It mixes personal stories, examples from artists and simple practices for beginning again.

books.title: The Language of the Soul: How the Words You Choose Shape the Life You Live
books.author: Mark Nepo
books.description: Traces the roots of more than two hundred words from many languages and traditions to recover their older, fuller meanings. Each short entry suggests how a word might be lived more fully.

courses.title: The Life of Expression: Your Life as a Work of Art
courses.description: Three evening seminars on Zoom hosted by the Milan Center for Mindfulness (Sati Mudita), with Italian translation. The sessions look at feeling, dialogue and writing as ways to give form to inner life.
courses.price: 75 EUR (85 USD) plus dana, and a 25 EUR (30 USD) annual membership card

courses.title: The Language of the Soul: The Power to Awaken, Connect, and Heal
courses.description: A three-session online webinar on Sunday afternoons (US Eastern time), built around his book on the roots of words. Participants explore how older meanings of familiar words can bring fresh attention to daily life.

courses.title: Creativity in the Second Half of Life (MEA 5-Day Immersion)
courses.description: A five-day residential programme at the Modern Elder Academy's oceanfront campus in Baja, Mexico. Drawing on The Fifth Season, it explores creativity and renewal for those past midlife; currently on a waitlist.

courses.title: The Fifth Season: A Castle Retreat with Mark Nepo
courses.description: A week at Castello di Pavone in Piedmont, Italy, combining poetry sessions with excursions in the region. The theme is creativity and meaning in later life.
courses.price: $4,895 USD per person sharing, $6,595 USD single

courses.title: The Language of the Soul
courses.description: A weekend workshop on Omega's Rhinebeck campus exploring the original meanings of words and how they can help us feel more awake and connected. Includes time for writing, conversation and an evening reading.
